messages.author: Anssi Heikura
messages.text: Ville, PE-05 BGP sessions to both upstreams are flapping since the 11.2 firmware upgrade at 13:50. The line card ports are logging link flaps too.

messages.author: Ville Laakso
messages.text: Which line card is it? Check the revision.

messages.author: Ville Laakso
messages.text: That matches the vendor note for 11.2 on LC-2: port flaps until patch 11.2.1 is installed. Pasi, can you put the patch on PE-05? It needs no reload.

messages.author: Anssi Heikura
messages.text: Did you see the football last night? That last minute goal was unreal.

messages.author: Anssi Heikura
messages.text: Sessions have been up for 15 minutes, no port flaps.

messages.author: Pasi Tuomi
messages.text: Two hours now and still clean.

messages.author: Ville Laakso
messages.text: Good. I will write it up.
